# Robert Fernandez — Cross-Platform Software Engineer & Digital Artist

> Design-first software systems across web, desktop, mobile, Wear OS, embedded displays, and retro consoles.

## Core Specializations
- **Cross-Platform & Native Systems**: React, TypeScript, Flutter, Go, C++, Lua, SFML, Love2D.
- **Aviation & Precision Calculators**: AviationPro Electronic Flight Bag (EFB), live NOAA METAR/TAF decoders, density altitude, weight and balance calculations.
- **Retro Computing & Embedded Displays**: Game development and custom utilities for PSP, Xbox, and embedded hardware interfaces.
